meta..write: auth != null && data.exists() && (data.child('hostId').val() == auth.uid || ((!root.child('rooms').child($roomId).child('players').child(data.child('hostId').val()).exists() || root.child('rooms').child($roomId).child('players').child(data.child('hostId').val()).child('isConnected').val() == false) && root.child('rooms').child($roomId).child('players').child(auth.uid).exists() && newData.child('hostId').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('hostEpoch').val() == data.child('hostEpoch').val() + 1))
meta..validate: newData.hasChildren(['roomId', 'hostId', 'hostEpoch', 'status', 'maxPlayers']) && newData.child('roomId').val() == $roomId && newData.child('maxPlayers').isNumber() && newData.child('maxPlayers').val() >= 2 && newData.child('maxPlayers').val() <= 4 && newData.child('hostEpoch').isNumber() && newData.child('hostEpoch').val() >= 1 && (!data.exists() || (newData.child('hostId').val() == data.child('hostId').val() && newData.child('hostEpoch').val() >= data.child('hostEpoch').val()) || (newData.child('hostId').val() != data.child('hostId').val() && newData.child('hostEpoch').val() == data.child('hostEpoch').val() + 1))

status..validate: newData.val() == 'CREATING' || newData.val() == 'LOBBY' || newData.val() == 'STARTING' || newData.val() == 'IN_GAME' || newData.val() == 'PAUSED' || newData.val() == 'RECONNECTING' || newData.val() == 'COMPLETED' || newData.val() == 'ABANDONED'

$actionId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['actionId', 'sequence', 'type', 'playerId', 'expectedVersion', 'expectedHostEpoch']) && newData.child('actionId').val() == $actionId && newData.child('actionId').isString() && newData.child('playerId').isString() && newData.child('playerId').val().length > 0 && newData.child('payload').isString() && newData.child('payload').val().length < 256 && (newData.child('type').val() == 'ROLL_DICE' || newData.child('type').val() == 'MOVE_PIECE' || newData.child('type').val() == 'PASS_TURN') && newData.child('expectedVersion').isNumber() && newData.child('expectedVersion').val() >= 0 && newData.child('expectedHostEpoch').val() == root.child('rooms').child($roomId).child('meta').child('hostEpoch').val()

$chatId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id', 'senderId', 'senderName']) && newData.child('id').val() == $chatId && newData.child('senderName').isString() && newData.child('senderName').val().length > 0 && newData.child('senderName').val().length <= 30 && ((!newData.hasChild('message') || (newData.child('message').isString() && newData.child('message').val().length <= 280)) && (!newData.hasChild('emoteId') || (newData.child('emoteId').isString() && newData.child('emoteId').val().length <= 64)))
